summary: Verified SEO content additions on Sitemap, Blog, Contact, FAQ pages. All new sections render with substantial text (word counts 350-390 per page, well above 200 threshold). Home renders unchanged — no regression. No console errors on any page. JS bundle compression: preview is served by CRA dev server (bundle.js, not main.{hash}.js), so preview URL cannot be used to verify production gzip; confirmed Content-Encoding header is NOT present on preview JS — platform limitation as described. Mobile 375px: Sitemap, Blog, FAQ have no horizontal overflow; Contact page has a pre-existing minor overflow (document width 419 vs viewport 375) caused by the long email string 'Saskstartupsolutions@viciconsulting.ca' inside the black info card (p-8 padding + non-breaking text) — unrelated to the new 'Why Businesses Choose Us' section.

issues: Horizontal overflow of 44px caused by long email address 'Saskstartupsolutions@viciconsulting.ca' inside the black contact info card. Fix: add 'break-all' or 'break-words' class to the <a> containing the email, or reduce p-8 padding on mobile. Pre-existing, not introduced by this iteration's content additions.

action_items: (Optional) Add 'break-all' class to the email link on Contact page to resolve pre-existing mobile overflow.
JS gzip compression is a platform limitation — document it and proceed; preview serves CRA dev server (bundle.js, no Content-Encoding). Production build/CDN must handle gzip/brotli.
critical_code_review_comments: All new content sections use semantic h2 + aria-labelledby — good for SEO and a11y.
Data-testid present on key elements (sitemap-page, blog-page, contact-page, faq-page, blog-book-btn).
Sitemap articles section only renders if posts array non-empty — graceful fallback.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 5 pages render with expected new content and no console errors)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Content additions on Sitemap/Blog/Contact/FAQ verified on preview. Preview serves CRA dev server so the production JS hash (main.aff8c64d.js) is not reachable via preview URL — only bundle.js is present. The Content-Encoding header check must be done against a production/deployed build, not preview. Minor pre-existing mobile overflow on Contact page due to long email string.
rca of the issue: Contact mobile overflow RCA: the <a> tag wrapping 'Saskstartupsolutions@viciconsulting.ca' has no word-break styling; at 375px viewport minus px-4 and p-8 padding the available width (~279px) is less than the email's rendered width, forcing its flex LI parent and the card to exceed viewport. Mitigation: add Tailwind 'break-all' on the mailto link.
